article.body_preview:
DHAKA, Oct. 12 (Xinhua) -- Inflation in Bangladesh accelerated to 9.52 percent in August, the highest in 10 years, mainly driven by higher food prices, the Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics (BBS) has reported.

In addition, the country's overall inflation eased slightly to 9.10 percent in September, according to Planning Minister MA Mannan on Tuesday.

Data showed that food inflation soared to 9.94 percent in August, the highest since April of 2012, and eased slightly to 9.08 percent in September.
